en.title: Energy & Fatigue
en.who: Guests who mark tired all the time, an afternoon crash, sleepy after meals, drained after work, or running on coffee. If sleep itself is the problem, use Sleep & Stress.
studyWhy: hungry cells need food, not medicine

say: I totally get it. You hit a wall in the afternoon, and by the time you get home there's nothing left. And coffee doesn't really fix it anymore, right?
feel.tip: Say back what they marked, in their words. Then ask: "When does it hit you most?"

say: Honestly, I've been there. [Your story in a line or two: when it was, what it felt like, what you tried that didn't work.]
felt.tip: Your own story, or someone close to you ("my mom", "a friend from work"). No story yet? "A lot of the people I talk to say exactly the same thing." Never make one up.

say: What I learned is that being tired usually isn't about needing more sleep or more coffee. The body ran out of the raw materials that turn food into energy, like the B vitamins, minerals and protein, and a rushed lunch doesn't put them back.
And being sleepy after lunch is a sugar spike. You don't have to stop eating rice, you just slow the sugar down: vegetables and protein first, rice last.
So this is what I'd start with.
found.tip: Two or three sentences, then go to the map. Pick the row that matches what they marked.

map: Tired all the time, drained after work
Double X
Fills the gaps a busy week of eating leaves
Running on coffee, foggy
Vitamin B Complex
Helps the body turn food into energy
Sleepy after lunch
Carb Blocker, Prebiotic Fiber, or a Plant Protein shake
Slows the sugar spike
Late nights, drinks, takeout
Liver Support, in the evening with Vitamin B
Supports a liver that's been working overtime
Stressed and wired
Ashwagandha, Vitamin C, Advanced Omega
Calms the stress system from the inside
A woman tired all the time, heavy periods
Iron & Folic Acid, only after a ferritin test
Low iron is a common hidden cause
en.ask: Based on what you told me, I'd start with the Double X and the B vitamins. Do you want to take it home tonight?
en.doctor: Tired for more than a few weeks, or with weight loss, breathlessness, very heavy periods or low mood? See a doctor first.

zh.title: 精力与疲劳
zh.who: 适合在问卷里勾了总是很累、下午犯困、饭后想睡、下班后被掏空、全靠咖啡撑的客人。如果主要是睡不好，用「睡眠与压力」。
studyWhy: 细胞饿了需要的是食物，不是药

say: 我特别懂。下午一到就没电，下班回到家整个人都空了。而且咖啡好像也越来越不管用了，对吧？
feel.tip: 用对方自己的话，把问卷上勾的说回去。然后问一句：“一般什么时候最明显？”

say: 说实话，我也经历过。[你的故事，一两句就好：什么时候、什么感觉、试过什么没用。]
felt.tip: 讲你自己的，或者身边人的（“我妈妈”“我一个同事”）。还没有故事？就说：“我身边很多朋友也是这样。”千万别编。

say: 我后来才知道，累通常不是因为睡得不够、咖啡喝得不够，而是身体把那些把食物变成能量的原料用光了，像B族、矿物质、蛋白质。一顿匆忙的午饭是补不回来的。
还有，午饭后犯困其实是血糖冲高再掉下来。不用戒米饭，只要让糖慢下来：先吃菜和肉，最后吃饭。
所以，我会先从这个开始。
found.tip: 两三句就够，然后看下面的对照表，挑跟对方勾的那一项对得上的。

map: 总是累、下班后被掏空
双X综合营养片
补上忙碌饮食留下的缺口
全靠咖啡撑、脑子发懵
B族维生素
帮身体把食物变成能量
午饭后犯困
阻碳片、益生元纤维粉，或一杯植物蛋白
让血糖慢下来
熬夜、应酬、外卖多
护肝片，晚上和B族一起吃
给一直在加班的肝减负
压力大、又累又亢奋
南非醉茄、维生素C、深海鱼油
从身体里面让压力系统平静下来
总是很累的女生、经量多
铁质叶酸片，先查铁蛋白再补
缺铁是很常见的隐藏原因
zh.ask: 按你刚才说的，我建议先从双X和B族开始。今天要不要先带回去？
zh.doctor: 如果累了已经好几周，或者同时有体重下降、气短、经量很多、情绪低落，请先去看医生。
